# Qwen3-VL LM-side seams

Generated by `../../../examples/refgen/qwen3vl_lm_ref.py` on the M3 Ultra (100.100.141.123) with
**transformers 5.1.0 / torch 2.11.0**, checkpoint `Qwen/Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B` snapshot
`9f2f7e710d6d81056aa5c0a4f04764fec6bb7bda` — the same snapshot the tower fixtures use.

| file | what |
|---|---|
| `ref.embed`  | `[12, 2048]` inputs_embeds AFTER image tokens are replaced by merger output |
| `ref.layer0` | `[12, 2048]` hidden after LM layer 0, i.e. after deepstack **0** is added |
| `ref.layer1` | `[12, 2048]` after LM layer 1 + deepstack **1** |
| `ref.layer2` | `[12, 2048]` after LM layer 2 + deepstack **2** |
| `ref.final`  | `[12, 2048]` `last_hidden_state`, post-norm |
| `ref.meta`   | ids, image token id, grid, image positions, dims |

⛔ **Pixels are NOT here.** They are byte-identical to `../qwen3vl_vision/ref.px` (same synthetic
formula, same 4x4 grid), and a second copy is a second thing to drift. Read them from there.

⛔ **The injection point is the thing to get right.** Deepstack features come from VISION blocks
`[5, 11, 17]` but are added at **LM layers 0, 1, 2** — after each layer runs, at image-token
positions only (`hidden[visual_pos_mask] += deepstack[layer_idx]`). Vision index and LM layer are
different numbers and pairing them by value would silently inject at layers 5/11/17.

⛔⛔ **THE <vision_start> MARKER IS LOAD-BEARING.** The first version of these fixtures used
`[text, text, IMG*4, text...]` with no marker, and transformers located ZERO images: it finds them by
scanning for `vision_start_token_id` and reading the token after it. It then fell through to the text
branch and gave the rotary plain positions `0..9` on all three axes. The forward still ran, the image
embeddings were still spliced in, deepstack was still applied — only mRoPE silently never happened.
The fixture looked multimodal and was a text-position capture, and Ferric (which computes the real
mRoPE positions) "failed" against it by 3.0e-2 at layer 0. The generator now asserts the three
position axes are not identical, so this cannot recur silently.

⚠ These were captured with forward PRE-hooks on layers 0..4, because a layer's forward hook fires
BEFORE `_deepstack_process`, which the loop applies to the returned tensor. The input to layer k+1
is therefore the post-injection state; a post-hook on layer k would have captured the state one
addition too early, and the numbers would have looked plausible.
